title: Established Prescriber Days on a Transition Fill
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — prescriber relationship clause.** A transition fill written by a prescriber with whom the member has an established paid refill history carries established prescriber days.

**Clause.** The established prescriber days are two (2) where the prescriber on the rejection wrote two or more of the member's paid refills in the last three months, one (1) where the prescriber wrote exactly one, and nothing otherwise.

The prescriber on the rejection is the prescriber on the latest counter rejection for non-formulary status on the member's pharmacy coverage. The refills counted are the member's paid refills on the pharmacy claims with that prescriber and a fill date in the last three months, of any drug. The days are added to the transition fill days.

### Table

| Paid refills written by the rejection's prescriber, last three months | Established prescriber days |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 2 |
| Exactly one | 1 |
| None | Nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- The rejection's prescriber wrote three paid refills of two different drugs in the last three months: 2 days.
- The prescriber wrote one paid refill four months ago and none since: nothing.
